description: This file defines classes and enums for representing and generating parts of an Xcode project file, including objects like targets, build phases, file references, and configurations. It is part of a codebase related to project file generation for Xcode, based on gyp.

classes.name: PBXObject
classes.description: Base class for all project objects, providing common interface and ID management.

classes.name: PBXTarget
classes.description: Represents a build target in the project, with dependencies and build phases.

classes.name: PBXAggregateTarget
classes.description: Represents an aggregate target, a specialized type of PBXTarget.

classes.name: PBXBuildFile
classes.description: Represents a build file associated with a build phase.

classes.name: PBXContainerItemProxy
classes.description: Proxy object linking targets and project items.

classes.name: PBXFileReference
classes.description: Represents a file reference in the project.

classes.name: PBXGroup
classes.description: Container for grouping files and other objects.

classes.name: PBXNativeTarget
classes.description: Native build target with associated resources and product references.

classes.name: PBXProject
classes.description: Represents the entire Xcode project, containing targets, groups, and configurations.

classes.name: PBXShellScriptBuildPhase
classes.description: Build phase for executing shell scripts.

classes.name: XCConfigurationList
classes.description: List of build configurations for an object.
